subject: Private Deploy Exception: scope & ops workback (FinServ pilot)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy exception - scope & ops workback (FinServ pilot)

Team —

Quick summary: FinServ wants to pilot a VPC/on-prem variant for a subset of workloads in Q2. They asked for a written scope and a realistic ops workback we can give them by end of next week. They flagged three nonstandard asks:

- Dedicated key management integration (customer KMS)
- Air-gapped ability for model downloads during initial provisioning
- 24x7 on-call for the first 60 days with runbook handoff

Please treat this as an exception request (they will be evaluated for an enterprise contract). I need a short doc covering: minimal infra changes, staffing delta (FTET or contractor), expected timeline (optimistic / realistic), and any blockers we should escalate to leadership.

Attachments: vpc-exception-matrix.xlsx (template), networking-delta-diagram.svg (current ask sketch).

Can each of you reply with your area-specific one-pagers (bullet lists) rather than long essays. I’ll compile and send to FinServ and Legal.

Thanks,
Lauren
Product Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy exception - scope & ops workback (FinServ pilot)

Thanks Lauren — quick technical notes below. I kept these as discrete bullets for the one-pager.

- KMS: We can support a customer-managed KMS via our KMS adapter but this requires: a) a small secure bootstrap agent deployed in customer network, b) validated key rotation flow (2 dev-days), and c) an updated config-at-rest contract. Risk: adds ~1 month to security sign-off.
- Air-gapped model downloads: feasible but we must pre-sign binaries and provide an offline ingestion tool. This is a separate delivery from the standard model registry flow; estimate 3 engineer-weeks to stabilize for one model family.
- Networking: The diagram shows peered VPC + private link. We need to confirm whether FinServ expects cross-region failover; if yes, NAT/firewall rules and latency SLAs increase complexity.
- Observability: For the pilot we can ship light-weight agent metrics but not full tracing; full tracing will require an additional 2 weeks and an increase in storage retention.

Blockers / unknowns for scoping:
- Which model families are in scope (Llama-2 variants vs small foundation-models)? Different models change RAM/GPU/Ops significantly.
- Expected qps / peak tokens distribution — this materially affects autoscale / dedicated pool sizing.

I attached a rough capacity-impact CSV (capacity-estimates.csv) with ballpark vCPU/GPU numbers for two scenarios.

-Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Mar 2028 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy exception - scope & ops workback (FinServ pilot)

+1 to Marcus — adding ops/resourcing perspective.

> KMS: We can support a customer-managed KMS via our KMS adapter but this requires a small secure bootstrap agent deployed in customer network

- Staffing: To operate the pilot we need 0.5 FTE SRE for provisioning (first 4 weeks), plus 1 FTE on-call coverage (handed to CS after initial 60 days). If the customer requires 24x7 from day one we need to add an external contractor or shift bench SREs; expected incremental cost: ~$45k for the 60-day window.
- Runbooks & handoff: We need runbook templates + DR playbook; estimate 3 author-days from the ops-docs team + 2 walkthrough sessions.
- Timeline (optimistic / realistic):
  - Optimistic: 4 weeks from sign-off (limited model family, no cross-region failover, customer provides presigned model artifacts).
  - Realistic: 8-10 weeks (includes security review, KMS validation, audit of customer infra).

Attachments: capacity-estimates.csv

I'll also note we should ask Legal for a scoped SLA carve-out in the pilot agreement.

-Karthik
Head of Platform Eng

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, FinServ - sue.bryant@finserv.com
Date: Tue, 26 Mar 2028 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy exception - scope & ops workback (FinServ pilot)

Thanks all — consolidating and next steps below. I converted the bullets into discrete action items so Lauren can send the exception packet to Legal/RevOps.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Marcus: Produce an engineering one-pager with explicit model families and a short checklist for KMS bootstrap (deliverable: eng-onepager.md). ETA: 2028-03-29 EOD.
- Karthik: Finalize staffing delta note + dollarized contractor estimate (deliverable: ops-staffing-note.pdf). ETA: 2028-03-30 AM.
- Lauren: Produce the exception cover note and share with Legal & RevOps. ETA: 2028-04-01.
- Soojin: Schedule a 45-minute triage with FinServ + Legal to go over carve-outs (meeting invite to FinServ sent). ETA: 2028-03-28 10:00 PT.

Decision calls we made in-thread:
- Pilot scope will exclude cross-region failover in the initial phase.
- We will require presigned model artifacts from FinServ for the pilot to avoid airgap ingestion work.

Open items to surface to leadership:
- Whether we approve the 60-day 24x7 handoff cost as a billable pass-through or absorb into the pilot credit.
- Approval for a scoped SLA carve-out during pilot (Legal).

Attachments referenced: vpc-exception-matrix.xlsx, networking-delta-diagram.svg, capacity-estimates.csv

I will compile the packet once Marcus/Karthik drop their docs.

Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
